research.title: Composition and calculation: hundredths and thousandths
research.retrieval: Actual public HTML introduction and TeachingPoints1–8, especially8, lines61–77. Linked guide/representations not retrieved.

research.title: Decimats (understanding fractions)
research.retrieval: Actual public HTML purpose/resources and transcript text, especially part3lines554–578, plus parts/whole and equivalent-partition discussion. Video itself not watched, spinnerPDF not downloaded.
research.adopted: Explicitly keep original whole while partitioning one hundredth into ten equal thousandths. Offer paper magnification and own place-value representation with equivalent trailing zeros.
